channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Brick Buddies
item.description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

item.title: Casualties: Unknown
item.description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

item.title: Casualties: Unknown Soundtrack
item.description: This is additional content for Casualties: Unknown, but does not include the base game.

item.title: DREADMOOR
item.description: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

item.title: Dying Light: The Following
item.description: Experience the untold chapter of Kyle Crane's story set in a vast breathtaking region outside the city of Harran. Leave the city walls behind and discover a countryside full of mysterious characters, deadly weapons and blood-chilling quests.

item.title: Funeral for the Sun
item.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

item.title: Hell Wait
item.description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

item.title: Stick A Fork
item.description: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

item.title: Age of Wonders 4: Eldritch Realms
item.description: The Umbral Abyss is yours to conquer in Age of Wonders 4: Eldritch Realms. Rule as an Eldritch Sovereign, wield terrifying new tomes of magic, survive world-altering global events and lead your people against the darkness before it spreads across the realms.

item.title: Dice A Million
item.description: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.

item.title: Sailing Era
item.description: Every voyage is a journey of "Sailing & Beyond" in Sailing Era! Navigate your fleet and sail for fun; run a business; have a romantic encounter in the tavern; capture pirates amid intense battle; explore inland for treasure... Experience foreign culture, make novel discoveries, and sail away!

item.title: Timber Rush
item.description: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
